record: HH15 E2101 H1 predeclared one-shot probe
authorizedBy: root followup: Nativeepoch00 assigned H1E2101; bounded actual volatile controller/runtime/renderPublicSite TREE forgot probe

scope.probe: one synthetic volatile fixture run using current createFixtureProvider/createServiceRuntime/createPublicController/renderPublicSite; initialize forgot route, inspect source-equivalent delegated email input, exercise updateDraft, route reentry, and valid/invalid/blank controller dispatch controls

preparationFindings.appSubmit: app.mjs delegated submit prevents default, calls form.reportValidity(), then constructs new FormData(form), projects entries, and dispatches the named event; native browser validation/FormData will not be executed in this TREE-only probe
preparationFindings.appInput: app.mjs delegated input listener calls controller.updateDraft(target.name, target.value) when target.name exists
preparationFindings.forgotField: public-site.mjs renders required type=email input named email with empty value and copy promising reset instructions by email
preparationFindings.controller: public-controller.mjs updateDraft currently handles email for login/register/contact, not forgot; public:forgot validates payload email, sets explicit local-simulation/no-email-sent outcome, and does not call runtime
preparationFindings.provider: fixture provider is the actual local fixture implementation; capabilities report realMail false; HH_PORTS is authoritative provider inventory and contains no email/reset port

expectedObservations: Initial route is reachable as page=forgot; rendered copy, form identity, and initial fields are recorded exactly.

Calling the same updateDraft(name,value) operation used by the delegated input listener returns false for the forgot email field. Because false does not notify/rerender, the captured TREE may still be the original emitted blank tree; do not treat that as an observation of a mounted typed DOM value.
After leaving for login and re-entering via forgot-password alias, capture the newly emitted TREE default. Any retention behavior is reported as observed only, not presumed defective.
A valid synthetic .test email dispatch returns the existing local-only/no-email-sent result; malformed and blank direct-controller controls are recorded separately.
Per-port fixture invocation counts and runtime receipt/Part deltas are measured from the post-initialization baseline, so initialization reads are not misattributed to forgot submit.
Volatile fixture state and storage capabilities are recorded; no email value is expected to enter runtime state, PxC Parts, provider persistence, or storage.

falsifiersAndInterpretation.copyCapabilityHypothesisFalsifiedIf: current rendered copy accurately says no reset email is sent or a real email/reset provider capability exists and the valid forgot action actually invokes it (must still remain local-only unless separately authorized)
falsifiersAndInterpretation.retention: missing retained email alone is not classified as unacceptable; report accepted/rejected updateDraft, TREE values, and reentry outcome separately
falsifiersAndInterpretation.notAProductAssertion: This probe records reachable synthetic behavior, not browser-native required/email validity, mounted DOM behavior, real backend capability, production service behavior, or human acceptance.

controls.retryPolicy: STOP on the first execution/probe failure; no automated retry and no overwrite of original captures
controls.externalEffects: No network, email, backend, account, production authority, mounted browser, native FormData/reportValidity execution, product edit, Git mutation, or native registry/state mutation.

outputPolicy.source: probe.mjs and run-once.sh are saved before the first execution; original raw captures are immutable after execution.
outputPolicy.red: If an expected-defect assertion is introduced and it fails, stop and report reached/unreached checks without repair or rerun. The probe records observations rather than asserting product expectations.
